PLFILT_TilesWithRiver.source: Pre-filter: {0} tiles with at least one river.

LanguageData.PLFILT_TilesWithRiver: 预过滤：{0} 个至少包含一条河流的瓦片。

PLFILT_TilesWithRoad.source: Pre-filter: {0} tiles with at least one road.

LanguageData.PLFILT_TilesWithRoad: 预过滤器：{0}至少有一条道路的瓷砖。

PLFILT_ValidTilesRemainAfterFilter.source: Pre-filter: {0} valid tile(s) remain(s) after filtering ({1} tile(s) removed).

LanguageData.PLFILT_ValidTilesRemainAfterFilter: 预过滤器：过滤后{0}个有效磁贴保留（{1}个磁贴已删除）。

PLGOPT_DisableWorldDataDescription.source: Allow disabling World Data: World Data are various data used by PrepareLanding to display information about the world.If set, this removes the information, saves some memory and some CPU cycles. In return less information is available.

LanguageData.PLGOPT_DisableWorldDataDescription: 允许禁用世界数据：世界数据是PrepareLanding用于显示有关世界信息的各种数据。启用此选项后，将移除这些信息，从而节省部分内存和CPU资源。作为回报，可获得的信息也更少。
LanguageData.PLMWBB_LoadOrSaveFilterPresets: 加载或保存过滤器预设。

PLMWFTIL_GoToEndOfList.source: Go to the end of the tile list.

PLMWFTIL_GoToNextListPage.source: Go to next page of the list.

PLMWFTIL_GoToPreviousListPage.source: Go to previous page of the list.

PLMWFTIL_GoToStartOfTileList.source: Go to the start of the tile list.

PLMWLODSAV_GoToEndOfList.source: Go to the end of the items list.

PLMWLODSAV_GoToNextListPage.source: Go to next page of the list.

PLMWLODSAV_GoToPreviousListPage.source: Go to previous page of the list.

PLMWLODSAV_GoToStartOfItemList.source: Go to the start of the item list.

PLMWT2T_TempPickTileOnWorldMap.source: Pick a tile on the world map!

LanguageData.PLMWT2T_TempPickTileOnWorldMap: 在世界地图上选一块瓷砖！

PLMWTT_ButtonAllTooltip.source: Set all elements to the On state.

LanguageData.PLMWTT_ButtonAllTooltip: 将所有元素设置为On状态。

PLMWTT_ButtonNoneTooltip.source: Set all elements to the Off state.

LanguageData.PLMWTT_ButtonNoneTooltip: 将所有元素设置为“关闭”状态。

PLMWTT_ButtonResetTooltip.source: Reset all elements to their default (Partial) state.

LanguageData.PLMWTT_ButtonResetTooltip: 将所有元素重置为其默认（部分）状态。

PLMWTT_IsCoastalTileLakeTooltip.source: A lake is at most 15 tiles of water surrounded by land.

LanguageData.PLMWTT_IsCoastalTileLakeTooltip: 一个湖最多有15片水，周围是陆地。

PLMWTT_ORANDTooltip.source: Type of filtering to apply. OR: each item is evaluated independently. AND: all items are evaluated together.

LanguageData.PLMWTT_ORANDTooltip: 要应用的过滤类型。 或者：每个项目均独立评估。 并且：所有条件将同时进行求值。

PLMWTT_StoneOrderTooltip.source: Whether Stone Filtering is order dependent or not. Press button to change filter state.

LanguageData.PLMWTT_StoneOrderTooltip: 石头过滤是否依赖于订单。 按按钮更改过滤器状态。

PLMWTT_UseCoastalRoationTooltip.source: Allow to search for coastal ocean/sea tiles which have a coast facing a specific direction.

LanguageData.PLMWTT_UseCoastalRoationTooltip: 允许搜索具有面向特定方向的海岸的沿海海洋/海洋瓷砖。

PLMWTT_UseNumberOfStoneTypesToolTip.source: Filter tiles that have only the given number of stone types (whatever the types are). This disables the other stone filters.

LanguageData.PLMWTT_UseNumberOfStoneTypesToolTip: 仅具有给定数量的石材类型（无论类型如何）的过滤砖。这将禁用其他石过滤器。

PLOPT_AllowImpassableTilesToolTip.source: Allow selection and filtering of impassable tiles.

LanguageData.PLOPT_AllowImpassableTilesToolTip: 允许选择并过滤不可通行的地形格。

PLOPT_AllowInvalidTilesForNewSettlement.source: Allow Invalid Tiles for New Settlement

LanguageData.PLOPT_AllowInvalidTilesForNewSettlement: 允许新建定居点使用无效地形块

PLOPT_AllowInvalidTilesForNewSettlementT.source: If ON, this prevents a last pass that would have removed tiles deemed as not valid for a new settlement.

LanguageData.PLOPT_AllowInvalidTilesForNewSettlementT: 如果开启，这将防止最后一次通过，该次通过将移除被视为对新定居点无效的瓷砖。

PLOPT_AllowLiveFilteringToolTip.source: [Warning: CPU heavy] Allow filtering without pressing the "Filter" button.

LanguageData.PLOPT_AllowLiveFilteringToolTip: 【警告：CPU占用高】允许在不点击“筛选”按钮的情况下进行筛选。
LanguageData.PLOPT_BypassTileHighlighterMaximumToolTi: 允许高亮显示超过{0}个图块。

PLOPT_DisablePreFilterCheckToolTip.source: Disable the check where Biomes and Terrains must be selected with a world coverage >= 50%.

LanguageData.PLOPT_DisablePreFilterCheckToolTip: 禁用“生物群系与地形必须以不低于50%的世界覆盖率被选中”这一检查。

PLOPT_DisableTileBlinkingToolTip.source: Disable tile blinking ("breathing") for filtered tiles on the world map.

LanguageData.PLOPT_DisableTileBlinkingToolTip: 在世界地图上禁用过滤后的图块闪烁（“呼吸”）。
LanguageData.PLOPT_DisableTileHighlightingToolTip: 完全禁用磁贴高亮显示。

PLOPT_ResetAllFiltersOnNewWorld.source: Reset all filters on new world

LanguageData.PLOPT_ResetAllFiltersOnNewWorld: 重置新世界上的所有过滤器

PLOPT_ResetAllFiltersOnNewWorldToolTip.source: If ON, all filters are reset to their default state on a new generated world, otherwise the filters are kept in their previous state.

LanguageData.PLOPT_ResetAllFiltersOnNewWorldToolTip: 如果启用，新生成的世界将重置所有过滤器为默认状态；否则，过滤器将保留其先前的状态。

PLOPT_ShowDebugTileIdToolTip.source: Show the Debug Tile ID for the highlighted tiles.

LanguageData.PLOPT_ShowDebugTileIdToolTip: 显示突出显示的磁贴的调试磁贴ID。

PLOPT_ShowFilterHeavinessToolTip.source: Show filter heaviness (possible filter CPU calculation heaviness) on filter header in the GUI.

LanguageData.PLOPT_ShowFilterHeavinessToolTip: 在GUI中的过滤器标题上显示过滤器繁重程度（可能是过滤器CPU计算繁重程度）。

PLOPT_ViewPartialOffNoSelectToolTip.source: Allow to view the PartialOffNoSelect button on the GUI for grouped three state items.

LanguageData.PLOPT_ViewPartialOffNoSelectToolTip: 允许在GUI上为分组的三态项显示“PartialOffNoSelect”按钮。
